chunks: And when the buried alive girl is asked
ai.seo_question: What happens to the buried alive girl on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the resurrection of the 'ma'udah' (buried alive) as a distinct entity to answer the question of 'for what sin she was killed,' serving as a powerful critique of pre-Islamic tribal arrogance and patriarchal authority. The event underscores divine justice by holding the perpetrator accountable not just for the act, but for the arbitrary nature of the killing, reinforcing the concept of individual moral responsibility before God.
